image_transform.position: After existing resizing/cropping to 256x704, before model data-preprocessor normalization
image_transform.arithmetic: Float32; six views; preserve channel order
image_transform.blur: OpenCV GaussianBlur per view/channel, sigmaX=sigmaY, specified odd kernel size, BORDER_REFLECT_101
image_transform.noise: Independent additive standard-normal values across views, channels and pixels; multiply by specified standard deviation; clip to [0,255]. Generate array in (6,3,256,704) order.
image_transform.noise_seed: Unsigned big-endian integer from first eight SHA-256 bytes of UTF-8 text '20261002:camera_noise:' + sample_token
image_transform.noise_generator: NumPy PCG64; standard_normal(shape) then cast to float32. Same underlying noise realization at both severity levels.

calibration_transform.position: Packed metadata before model data preprocessing
calibration_transform.convention: Column vectors; homogeneous transforms; positive right-handed rotation about LiDAR-frame +Z through the LiDAR origin
calibration_transform.operation: For every camera, C2L_new = Rz(theta) @ C2L_original; L2C_new = inverse(C2L_new); L2IMG_new = K4 @ L2C_new.
calibration_transform.unchanged: Camera intrinsics, image augmentation matrices, images, point coordinates/features, GT and output coordinate frame
calibration_transform.interpretation: Common camera-rig-to-LiDAR extrinsic yaw error; not independent rotation about each camera optical centre
calibration_transform.validation: Check original matrix relationships, zero-angle identity, inverse consistency, rotation validity and projection consistency before accepting nonzero perturbations.

evaluation.ground_truth: Exact frozen 600 tokens; unchanged GT filtering
evaluation.comparison: Each corrupted condition minus fresh clean baseline

limitations: Synthetic Gaussian blur is not a full motion/defocus model.
Additive Gaussian noise is not a physical camera-noise model.
Noise uses one fixed realization per sample.
Calibration tests only common positive yaw offsets at two magnitudes.
No combined corruptions or robustness training.
600 selected frames; not full validation or independent replication.
No runtime, sensor-cost, safety or statistical significance claim.
